title: Welcome to SecondTab!
author: SecondTab
content: Welcome to SecondTab! A brand new website for accessing Proxies and other useful resources to take back control of the internet on restricted networks.
Check out the Proxies tab for ways to access blocked sites, or check out our official games site!
More features will be coming out soon to improve the site. Join our Discord while you're at it to stay updated. The invite link can be found in the Links tab.
